# Fixture index

- `source/README.md` maps parser fields and malformed-input boundaries to core check 10.
- `records/README.md` maps canonical identities, source joins and universe gates to core check 23.
- `taxonomy/README.md` maps external rank evidence and authored rule cases to core checks 30–32 and 34.
- `exports/README.md` maps export inputs and count conservation to core checks 41 and 42 and consumer check 30.
- `exports/expected/README.md` maps authored export bytes to core check 42 and consumer check 17.
- `exports/expected/all_rmsk/README.md` maps complete-catalog membership to core check 42.
- `consumers/README.md` maps parser identities, molecules and host collisions to consumer checks 00 and 10–25.
- `contigs/README.md` maps measured FASTA names and lengths to core checks 60 and 62.
- `gene/README.md` maps exon geometry and publication dependencies to core checks 81 and 83.
- `publication/README.md` maps complete synthetic builds to core checks 71–73, 82 and 83.

Each directory documents every fixture beside its reader; expectations are hand-authored.
